findings.title: Clear the stale zero-scale Canvas overrides
findings.rawBody:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Clear the stale zero-scale Canvas overrides**

At reviewed head `e3d581df42f3a25cfdfc319bca5509f8b5382ada`, retaining `FightMatchDemo.unity` unchanged also retains its prefab-instance overrides for RuntimeCanvas fileID `1013562322995895578`: `m_LocalScale.x/y/z` and `m_AnchorMax.x/y` remain zero (`Assets/Scenes/FightMatchDemo.unity:258-285`). Those overrides take precedence over the migrated prefab's unit scale, and `FightMatchResponsiveLayout.Apply()` explicitly rejects a non-positive Canvas `lossyScale`, so the real scene can enter the fail-closed layout gate while prefab-instantiation checks pass. The scoped design also required native save/reopen to leave no unexplained scene overrides; normalize or remove these overrides and publish the resulting scene asset rather than recording `NO_CHANGE`.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L290-L291](https://github.com/yyczz1/FightMatch/blob/e3d581df42f3a25cfdfc319bca5509f8b5382ada/AGENTS.md#L290-L291)
